system: civil law system with Islamic (sharia) law influences

constitution.amend: proposed by the Assembly or Mejlis; passage requires two-thirds majority vote or absolute majority approval in a referendum

courts.highest: Supreme Court of Turkmenistan (consists of the court president and 21 associate judges and organized into civil, criminal, and military chambers)
courts.judges: judges appointed by the president for 5-year terms
courts.lower: High Commercial Court; appellate courts; provincial, district, and city courts; military courts

citizenship.descent: at least one parent must be a citizen of Turkmenistan

world: has not submitted an ICJ jurisdiction declaration; non-party state to the ICCt
